title: Stock Joomla optional dependent columns cannot produce invalid SQL
steps: Run the MariaDB database merge suite with stock contact/banner column shapes.
expect: No asset_id is required for stock contacts or banners.
Article title changes still merge when unrelated optional columns are absent.
Either-side schema differences remain kept instead of generating invalid SQL.
Existing held contact and field dependents remain protected.

tests: stock Joomla contacts and banners without asset_id do not break dependent-row SQL
held contacts and custom fields keep live dependent rows off the copy
